label: sec:vectors-hadrons-intro
html: Having established the weight decomposition of forms, we now develop the trace and basis machinery for intertwiner spaces of tensor powers of the fundamental representation. We introduce the adjoint trace on endomorphisms, derived from the Frobenius pairing and the fibre-adjoint involution. This trace inherits cyclicity from the Frobenius relation and non-degeneracy from the positive-definiteness of the dagger. Next, we construct the Pawlowski--Leitner canonical basis on \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathrm{SU}(2)}(V_j, V_{1/2}^{\otimes n}). Indexed by standard Young tableaux with at most two rows, this basis emerges from contractions with the volume form along the unital Gröbner--Shirshov route, its dimension governed by the hook-length formula. Finally, we use the adjoint trace to equip the PawLei basis with an orthogonal inner product. This pairing coincides with the Frobenius form restricted to \mathrm{End}(V_j), ensuring that fibre integration commutes with the intertwiner expansion of hadron states.
